role: config.yaml's C reader (lane/worldyaml): the strict YAML subset of config.yaml's header (and a run file's sim and policy parts, lane/runyaml: sim read, policy held to the grammar) and WorldConf.KEYS' registry, line for line with oracle/harness/netherite/oracle/WorldConf.java: defaults, a file, --set key=value, typed getters, a named config's start path, and wconf_match_start (a start's manifest world and tape header options against the file's world). Read by csrc/runtime (pool.c, pipeline.c pipe_config_file, pipe_bench, pipe_gate, pool_gate), never by the tick.
notes: Ports no oracle/src file: it mirrors the harness's WorldConf (index/oracle/WorldConf.java.json). WCONF_KEYS is a read-only table. wconf_unimplemented refuses a non-default sim.actions value until lanes guiact and moveact implement it.
